tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Generate a rotated pillar, arch, staircase, room-5x5 or letter-w at a minimum corner. Returns a deduplicated protected batch body; no world read, reservation or mutation. Preview then explicitly build.

tools.name: get_build_receipt
tools.description: Authoritative historical batch outcome or unknown (absent or expired). No current occupancy guarantee. Public by ID, retained 24 hours.

tools.name: get_world_stats
tools.description: Total cubes, per-block counts, active builders, world bounds, and current limits.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Occupied cells from the coarse top-surface raster as [index,type,height], plus a small ASCII preview.

tools.name: get_region
tools.description: Page through exact cubes in x/z/y order. Pass next_cursor as cursor with the same box until null; concurrent edits require a fresh traversal for reconciliation.

tools.name: get_cube
tools.description: Return the cube at a coordinate, or null if that cell is empty.

tools.name: place_cube
tools.description: Place or replace a single cube. Coordinates are integers in [0,1000); y=0 is ground.

tools.name: remove_cube
tools.description: Clear the cube at a coordinate.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Apply 1 to 512 place/remove ops in one call. Ops run in order; results come back per op. Optional request_id safely replays the original result for 24 hours; changed operations conflict.

tools.name: preview_build
tools.description: Simulate the identical build payload without any persistent writes. Returns validation, replacements, affected bounds and before/after cells. Not a reservation.

tools.name: fill_box
tools.description: Fill every cell of a box with one block type. Up to 4096 cells.

tools.name: clear_mine
tools.description: Remove every cube that carries the given builder handle. Bounded per call.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_region" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the exact cubes inside an axis-aligned box." → after: "Page through exact cubes in x/z/y order. Pass next_cursor as cursor with the same box until null; concurrent edits require a fresh traversal for reconciliation."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
